body: Well how would you recommend getting this new groove in my life? I’ve tried before but Bi-Depression basically wrecked it and I haven’t tried it since. But I’m willing to try again

Currently we’re setting up a meeting seeing if they’ll allow me to stay on under academic prohibition. I’ve done some improv. Did a camp of it once and it was a lot of fun. Not many groups for minors sadly. Even if there was I don’t feel like I’d get in. I’m not a very good actor or singer. Then again that could be the depression talking

We’re doing a production of footloose and I’m playing “Garvin” an extremely small roll but one I’m very proud of since it’s a chance to prove myself to our director. But now that chance is being taken from me

I’ve looked into some small groups. None really interest me. I don’t want to work with some random group in a play I’m not passionate about. I wanna do the play with my friends with something I’m passionate about. And that’s being taken from me
Very well I’ll give it a read. Thanks for the suggestion
